g1.flow: Four surah openings, one odd ending, and it is Ghāfir's: 40:2 ends al-ʿalīm (the Knowing), then 40:3 begins ghāfir, 'forgiver of sin', the surah's own name. The other three end al-ḥakīm (the Wise): Az-Zumar 39:1, the only one with no Ḥā Mīm before it, then Al-Jāthiyah 45:2 and Al-Aḥqāf 46:2. Hook: ḥakīm, ʿalīm, ḥakīm, ḥakīm; Ghāfir's pair sounds alike: ʿazīz, ʿalīm.

cues.39:1: Az-Zumar: ayah 1, straight after Ṣād with no Ḥā Mīm; ends al-ḥakīm (the Wise).
cues.40:2: Ghāfir: al-ʿazīz al-ʿalīm, the only ʿalīm; next, 'forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance'.
cues.45:2: Al-Jāthiyah: al-ḥakīm, like Az-Zumar; next, 'within the heavens and earth are signs'.
cues.46:2: Al-Aḥqāf: al-ḥakīm again; next, heavens and earth created 'for a specified term'.

g2.flow: Same words in both; the ayat around them decide. Hūd 11:96 follows 'away with Madyan as Thamūd was taken away', then 'to Pharaoh and his establishment', who followed Pharaoh's command. Ghāfir 40:23 follows 'Allāh seized them… severe in punishment', then 'to Pharaoh, Hāmān and Qārūn', who called Moses 'a magician and a liar'. Hook: Hūd's next ayah names one; Ghāfir's names three.

cues.11:96: Hūd: after 'away with Madyan', like Thamūd; next, 'to Pharaoh and his establishment'.
cues.40:23: Ghāfir: after 'Allāh seized them… severe in punishment'; next, 'to Pharaoh, Hāmān and Qārūn'.

g3.flow: Ghāfir 40:76 starts straight with udkhulū (enter), carrying on the speech begun in 40:75, 'you used to exult upon the earth'; next, 'So be patient'. Az-Zumar 39:72 opens with qīla (it will be said), between its two 'in groups' (zumar) ayat: the disbelievers answer Hell's keepers, then qīla; next, the groups to Paradise. Hook: Ghāfir, one speech, no qīla; Az-Zumar, question, answer, then qīla.

cues.39:72: Az-Zumar: opens qīla, after 'Yes, but the word of punishment has come into effect'.
cues.40:76: Ghāfir: straight into udkhulū, after 'you used to behave insolently'; next, 'So be patient'.
